# Lawsyst

> > UK's #1 voted legal case management software system designed for solicitors across all practice areas with integrated billing, document management, and workflow automation.

Lawsyst is a comprehensive cloud-based legal practice management platform serving UK law firms and in-house legal teams. The platform provides specialized solutions across 15+ practice areas including criminal, family, commercial, and property law, with built-in compliance features for legal aid (LAA), SRA regulations, and AML requirements.

## Key Topics

- Case Management
- Practice Management Software
- Legal Document Management
- Billing & Invoicing
- Workflow Automation
- Cloud-Based Platform
- Legal Calendaring
- Time Tracking
- Criminal Law
- Family Law
- Commercial Law
- Property Law & Conveyancing
- Legal Aid Compliance
- AML Compliance
- SRA Regulations
